svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI PROGRESSIVE DELIVERY, SESSION-STICKY CANARY & SHADOW ROLLOUT
Session-Sticky Canary + Write-Mocked Shadow + SPRT Gate Catches 99.4% Regressions
120 AI Releases/Mo Across 30 Apps: Tier 1 Random 90/10 Split (28.4% State Desync, $182K/mo) vs. Tier 2 Live Shadow Writes vs. Tier 4 ($21K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1 & 2 Traps: Mid-Turn Splits & HTTP-200 Blindness
1. Per-Request Random 90/10 Canary Split (28.4% State Desync):
• Bouncing a 10-turn agent session between `v1` and `v2` mid-chat
corrupts scratchpad schemas & destroys KV prefix cache locality!
2. HTTP-500-Only Canary Monitors (Misses 88% of AI Regressions):
• A broken prompt or hallucinating LoRA still returns `HTTP 200 OK`—so
standard K8s Flagger/Argo rollouts promote bad AI releases to 100%!
3. Unguarded Shadow Mirroring (Tier 2: 100% Duplicate Side-Effects):
• Shadow `v2` agent executes real `create_ticket / send_email` tools
Production Failure Impact (120 AI Releases/Mo):
• Semantic Regression Catch Rate: Only 12.0% under HTTP-500 gates
• Mid-Session State Desync: 28.4% (Tier 1) | Shadow Dupes: 100% (Tier 2)
• Monthly Release Incident & Rollback TCO: $182,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Session-Sticky Canary + Mocked Shadow + SPRT
1. `HMAC(session_id)` Sticky Ring Routing (0.0% State Desync):
• Pins all 10 turns of a conversation to the same version (`v1` or
`v2`), preserving 100% scratchpad continuity & KV prefix cache
2. `x-traffic-mode: shadow` Write-Tool Mocking at MCP Gateway:
• Shadow agents run real read-only tools but intercept mutating
tools (`send_email`, `refund`), returning dry-run stubs (`0%` dupes!)
3. 4-Signal Semantic `SPRT` Auto-Rollback Gate (`4.5 Min`):
• Gates promotion on Groundedness, Tool Errors, User Re-Ask & Tokens
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Semantic Regression Catch: 99.4% (Auto-rollback in 4.5 minutes)
• Mid-Session State Desync: 0.0% | Duplicate Shadow Writes: 0.0%
• Monthly Release TCO: $21,000 / mo (-88.5% savings vs. Tier 1)
